prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet selection: Move sign-in to after pet selection so users choose their companion before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save your pet to an account", "body": "Sign in now to sync your new pet safely across all your devices."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive pet preview screen: Insert a interactive pet preview screen right after pet selection to show how the pet looks.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose your starter companion", "layout": "grid"}}
2: [home, redesign] Desktop control carousel on loading screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout showcasing an interactive desktop controls carousel while files load.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Setting up your desktop pet workspace", "body": "While your pet loads, check out these tips on how to interact with your pet on desktop.", "layout": "split", "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "label": "Desktop control tips", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Instant starter pet flow bypass: Add one-click instant starter pet choice cards on the selection screen to skip custom photo processing.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Select a ready-to-adopt companion", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Instant adoption pets", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account sync hint on sign-in screen: Display a hint warning returning users to use their original sign-in method to retain pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Important: Sign in with the same account you used before to keep existing pets.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop permission check during setup: Add a diagnostic checklist during the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay permissions.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Verifying screen overlay permissions", "style": "calm", "action": "next"}]}}
6: [finish, copy] Clear control instructions on home intro: Update the welcome text with explicit copy on right-clicking the pet to bring up desktop controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your pet is live on your desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or talk to them.", "hint": "Try right-clicking your pet on your desktop right now!"}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Two-column progress view for path selection: Switch choose_path screen to a clear two-column layout with visual step progress counter.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Choose your onboarding path"}}
8: [sign_in, notification] Account persistence notification: Show a notification explaining that account creation secures their pet against accidental data loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "We will email you a backup link so your pet remains safe across sign-ins.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Adoption rewards incentive banner on story screen: Add copy and high-emphasis button detailing unlockable pet accessories upon completing onboarding.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Adopt your desktop companion today", "body": "Complete setup to unlock custom accessories and desktop mini-games!", "button_label": "Start Adoption"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a new preview screen within onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen while preserving its core job is allowed.
Adding instant pet choice cards on the pick_friend screen is allowed.
Adding an account sync hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Adding a permission verification checklist to the waiting screen is allowed.
Updating text copy on the home intro screen is allowed.
Redesigning choose_path into a two-column view with progress indicators is allowed.
Adding account persistence notification copy to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions unlockable accessories and mini-games, violating the ban on mentioning gifts or free extras.
